messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER 🚨 elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway-usw2 (502 / 504 / timeouts). Service: inference-api. Alert ID: alert-7990012345. Paging oncall: @oncall-erin.
oncall-erin: I'm on it. Seeing spike starting ~00:06 UTC, ~12% 5xx at peak. Multiple customers affected.
eng-runtime-alice: Quick triage: logs show repeated segfaults in model-runner for model 'mosaic-v1-q8' on pool-rw-usw2-2. Sample crash: 
```
SIGSEGV at 0x0 in libquant_attention.so+0x1f2a
#0 0x7f2a1e4a in quant_attn_exec(...)
#1 0x7f2a0b3f in model_forward(...)
```
eng-runtime-alice: Also seeing OOMs preceding segfaults. dmesg: "Out of memory: GPU memory allocation failed" and GPU watchdog reset on GPU1.
sre-lead-charlie: Mitigation plan: throttle gateway concurrency, enable routing fallback to smaller model variant (mosaic-v1-q4), and enable CPU fallback for long requests. Aim to reduce memory pressure.
oncall-erin: Applying rate-limit rules now: global concurrency from 180 -> 60. Enabling routing fallback policy rp-7990012345.
eng-platform-bob: Routing change applied: 10% traffic shifted to mosaic-v1-q4 and immediate failover -> fallback for node failures. Draining pool-rw-usw2-2 (nodes with repeated crashes).
incidents-bot: Config change accepted (rp-7990012345). Monitoring updated.
cust-success-maria: Customer impact: acme-inc and betacorp reporting 502s since 00:06 UTC. Opening high-priority tickets and sending status template. Will provide customer list in 15m.
eng-runtime-alice: Core dumps collected (sanitized). Key snippet: 
```
#0 0x00007f2a1e4a quant_attn_exec
#1 0x00007f2a0b3f model_forward
#2 0x0000561b4ca2 main_infer_loop
reason: GPU mem fragmentation + failed alloc -> segfault
```
eng-runtime-alice: Immediate actions: rolling restart model-runner on 3 nodes, evict large KV cache entries to free memory. Starting now.
oncall-erin: Rolling restarts initiated. Expect short latency bump (~10-20%). Will update.
eng-runtime-alice: Hotpatch candidate identified: revert recent quant attention optimization (PR #4821). If restarts don't stabilize error rate to <1% we'll deploy rollback.
sre-lead-charlie: Runbook: if errors remain >5% after 15m post-restart -> approve hotpatch deploy.
oncall-erin: Metrics update: error rate dropped from 12% -> 3% after routing change + restarts. Baseline ~0.4%. Keeping pager open.
cust-success-maria: Notifying impacted customers that mitigation in progress; prepping proactive credit offer for enterprise tenants if SLA breach confirmed.
eng-platform-bob: Draining pool complete. Provisioning replacement nodes with non-quant kernel build. ETA 25m.
eng-runtime-alice: If hotpatch needed I'll cut a build and coordinate deploy (10m lead).
oncall-erin: Handoff note: I'll stay on for next 45m, then hand to @cust-success-maria-night for extended monitoring and follow-up. Adding incident doc: /incidents/7990012345 (please update with any findings).
sre-lead-charlie: Postmortem owners: @eng-runtime-alice (root cause + fix), @eng-platform-bob (orchestration + reprovision), @cust-success-maria (customer comms). Scheduling blameless postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
incidents-bot: Alert status: mitigated but not cleared. Continued monitoring for 1h. If 5xx >5% re-trigger. :rotating_light:
